mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, factory_id, workshop_id, production_line_id, groups_id, project_id, monomer_id, plan_id, product_type, ask_complete_time, complete_time, status, issue_status, user_id, order_number, quantity, print_quantity
mapper.select:
SELECT ord.*, dic.label 'dictionaryName', fac.name 'factoryName', shop.name 'workshopName', line.name 'productionLineName', us.name 'userName' FROM mes_enclosure_task_order ord LEFT JOIN mes_building_factory fac ON ord.factory_id = fac.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop shop ON ord.workshop_id=shop.id LEFT JOIN mes_enclosure_production_line line ON ord.production_line_id=line.id LEFT JOIN sys_user us ON ord.user_id=us.id LEFT join sys_dictionary dic ON ord.dictionary_id=dic.id and dic.bool_delete_enum=0 WHERE ord.bool_delete_enum=0 AND ord.project_id=#{projectId}
AND ord.order_number like CONCAT('%',#{orderNumber},'%')
AND us.`name` like CONCAT('%',#{userName},'%')
ORDER BY ord.create_time desc
